units.source_text: 请不要以为我在女人和人生的问题上遭受过两次挫折以后，就认命而消沉，变成了一个畏首畏尾的人。

en.t: Please do not think that after suffering two setbacks in matters of women and life, I resigned myself to fate, sank into gloom, and became a timid man.

units.source_text: 在1948年岁暮以前，碰上了好几次这样的巩会，其中也有柏木的辅导，我毫不畏惧地去做了。

en.t: Before the end of 1948, I encountered several such opportunities, and with Kashiwagi's guidance among them, I went ahead and did it without the slightest fear.
It always ended with the same result.
